messages:
maria_marketing: Quick thread  QuantaGrid case study status. We have the transcript + signed release but need final quote wording and legal thumbs-up by Thu so we can publish next Tues.

leo_seo: I'll draft three SEO headlines and short meta descriptions tonight. Any stat lock rules?

neha_cs: Customer approved one pull-quote but asked to avoid naming cloud vendors or contract numbers. They also asked we not state ARR. Attribution: 'P. Gomez, Director ML'. Signed release attached.

jonas_pm: Benchmarks: steady-state throughput ~2.6x, p95 latency from ~390ms -> ~150ms for their 900-token scenario. I'll drop a short methods blurb in the PR.

ava_design: Working on hero image + stat card. Which logo variant? Customer supplied horizontal + mark-only; they prefer the horizontal.

legal_bot: Please redact internal hostnames and remove any S3 paths or contract IDs. Keep quote verbatim as in signed PDF. Distribution: NA/EU OK; APAC requires extra consent.

maria_marketing: Proposed headline options: 1) "QuantaGrid scales inference with Redwood Dedicated" 2) "How QuantaGrid achieved predictable LLM serving in production" 3) "QuantaGrid sees nearly 3x throughput on Redwood"

leo_seo: Recommend 2 for case page, 1 for social, 3 as a paid-test. Avoid explicit percent cost claims unless customer approves.

neha_cs: Customer replied: they approve the exact quote and the latency numbers but asked to phrase throughput as "nearly 3x". They want publish timing Tue 10am PT and asked we not publish earlier. Signed PDF uploaded.

jonas_pm: I'll update the methods note to read: "Comparison against customer's prior mixed-host setup under steady replay. Traces and identifiers redacted." Will attach sanitized CSV.

asylvio_ops: (typo) sylvio_ops: Sanitized assets are in `s3://redwood-marketing/quantagrid/sanitized/2026-04-12/`. PR scanner will flag if anything left.

ava_design: Uploaded final assets to `design/marketing/quantagrid-case-v1.zip`. Left placeholder for the pull quote.

maria_marketing: Great. I'll open the PR and tag reviewers. Internal review deadline Fri 2pm PT. Publish Tue 10am PT per customer. Thanks team :rocket:

legal_bot: All clear to publish in NA/EU with the approved quote and redacted assets. Keep signed release in PR for records.

leo_seo: Adding meta + short social variants to the PR now.
